# Naviamp v2.11.0

Naviamp 2.11.0 expands Aurral discovery into a complete browsing and request hub, adds signed Flatpak installation and updates for Linux, and improves playback, internet radio and Android TV controls.

## Highlights

- Explore full Aurral recommendations, catalog search, artist and release pages, Trending charts and persistent request status from one discovery hub.
- Install and update the Linux app through the official signed Flatpak repository.
- Keep TV controls visible, choose new artwork layouts, and get more reliable playback and internet-radio metadata.

## Features

- Browse a dedicated Aurral hub with full Recommendations and Search pages, related artists, releases and editions, track previews, Trending charts and genre blocking. Track requests through waiting-for-release, acquisition and validated Library availability, including after reconnecting. ([Issue #383](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/383), [PR #527](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/527), [Issue #502](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/502), [PR #508](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/508))
- Install the Linux app as an official signed x86_64 Flatpak, with repository-managed updates and private application storage. ([Issue #292](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/292), [PR #550](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/550))
- Choose square album artwork corners and an artwork layout that fills the Now Playing artwork area. The shared settings follow export, import and sync. ([Issue #417](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/417), [PR #480](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/480), [Issue #418](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/418), [PR #481](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/481))
- Optionally keep Android TV Now Playing controls visible, preserving focus instead of hiding the controls after inactivity. Implemented and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #459](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/459), [PR #463](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/463))

## Improvements

- Show internet-radio station artwork supplied by the server in station lists and Now Playing. Implemented and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #458](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/458), [PR #462](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/462))
- Offer supported Radio methods and more varied Library mixes on Aurral, with artist-diversity limits and clearer capability handling. ([Issue #383](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/383), [PR #527](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/527))
- Distinguish Repeat Off, All and One with a clearly muted Off state and continuous-loop icons that remain legible at small sizes. ([Issue #557](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/557), [PR #558](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/558))
- Update Brazilian Portuguese and German translations, while removing obsolete strings from translation catalogs. Brazilian Portuguese translated by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #484](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/484), [PR #485](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/485), [Issue #523](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/523), [PR #524](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/524), [Issue #568](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/568), [PR #567](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/567), [Issue #560](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/560), [PR #562](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/562))

## Bug fixes

- Stop the old stream immediately when manually skipping to a track that takes time to load. Reported, fixed and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #465](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/465), [PR #467](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/467))
- Retry lyrics that were unavailable on the first lookup when you reopen them, without restarting the app. Reported, fixed and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #466](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/466), [PR #468](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/468))
- Start on Android systems where the Google Cast sender module is unavailable, including affected LineageOS/MicroG installations. Reported by @sewnie. ([Issue #391](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/391), [PR #479](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/479))
- Preserve an album’s saved playback profile when starting playback by selecting one of its tracks. ([Issue #532](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/532), [PR #529](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/529))
- Save the final paused playback position so a later restart restores the current checkpoint. ([Issue #438](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/438), [PR #530](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/530))
- Recover native output that appears started but whose audible clock stalls during playback startup. ([Issue #497](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/497), [PR #554](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/554))
- Prevent concurrent native callbacks from overwriting newer playback state or leaving Now Playing stuck at Loading. ([Issue #497](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/497), [PR #527](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/527))
- Display the initial announced internet-radio song title without waiting for the next title change, and keep titles scoped to the current playback session. Reported, fixed and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #455](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/455), [PR #456](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/456))
- Match internet-radio song artwork to the announced song instead of choosing another song by the same artist. Reported, fixed and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #457](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/457), [PR #461](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/461))
- Show only applicable Android TV live-radio controls, so every visible action is useful for the stream. Reported, fixed and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Issue #460](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/460), [PR #464](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/464))
- Restore Start Radio in album-track and current-track menus when supported by the server. ([Issue #519](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/519), [PR #528](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/528))
- Keep dropdown menus close to their anchors and position tooltips correctly before their first visible frame. ([Issue #547](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/547), [PR #548](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/548), [Issue #559](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/559), [PR #561](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/561))
- Keep connection fields clear of system bars when the on-screen keyboard opens. ([Issue #482](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/482), [PR #483](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/483))
- Attach Android native visualizers without waiting for an unrelated window redraw. ([Issue #544](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/544), [PR #545](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/545))

## Upgrade notes

- The local database upgrades automatically to store Aurral request history. Existing connections, settings and album playback profiles are retained. ([Issue #383](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/383), [PR #527](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/527))
- Aurral features follow server capabilities and account permissions; newer discovery and chart actions require a compatible Aurral API. Acquisition cancel/retry remains available through Aurral itself. ([Issue #502](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/502), [PR #508](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/508), [Issue #383](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/383), [PR #527](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/527))
- Update other devices to v2.11.0 before relying on synchronization of the new artwork and TV control settings. ([Issue #417](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/417), [PR #480](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/480), [Issue #418](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/418), [PR #481](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/481), [Issue #459](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/459), [PR #463](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/463))
- Flatpak updates are managed by Flatpak; close and reopen the app after an update. Existing non-Flatpak data is not imported automatically. ([Issue #292](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/292), [PR #550](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/550))
- The signed Flatpak currently packages v2.10.0. Its v2.11.0 update is pending access to the existing signing environment; use the direct Linux download for v2.11.0 until that update is published. ([Issue #569](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/569))

## Known issues

- The reported album Play-button Gapless override and Android TV queue-end Autoplay stop remain under investigation; related fixes do not establish their original causes. ([Issue #520](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/520))
- Android TV playback can restart after a stream failure or Wi-Fi interruption. Authenticated streams without finite byte ranges or provider time offsets retain buffered-seeking limitations.
- Google Cast requires online provider media and a reachable local network. Physical macOS Cast verification and broader offline, lyrics and audio-effect support remain follow-ups. ([Issue #221](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/221), [Issue #223](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/223))
- Intermittent Android 15 native-raster initial visibility and Windows initial-window presentation remain under investigation. Recent passing controls do not establish their original causes. ([Issue #330](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/330), [Issue #493](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/493))
- Further macOS and Linux presentation, performance and accessibility acceptance continues. Flatpak physical GNOME/KDE and hardware-GPU acceptance is still outstanding. ([Issue #342](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/342), [Issue #552](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/552), [Issue #203](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/203), [Issue #220](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/220))
- Android scrolling and progress animations can still use elevated CPU; the broader visualizer performance work remains separate. ([Issue #414](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/414), [Issue #241](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/241))
- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta. Direct GitHub Windows and macOS downloads are not publisher-signed; the iOS IPA requires signing for sideloading. ([Issue #128](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/128))
